\section[la educación]{la educación — education; manners}

\label{lesson:ES-C505-educacion}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: la educación}
\textbf{la educación} — \textquotedblleft{}education; manners\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
La educación es gratuita.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Education is free.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Tener buena educación} — to have good manners.

\section[asistir]{asistir — to attend}

\label{lesson:ES-C505-asistir}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Spanish for to damage, then the Spanish for education.

\subsection*{You'll want to know: asistir}
\textbf{asistir} — \textquotedblleft{}to attend\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Asisto a clase todos los días.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{I attend class every day.}
\end{quote}

A false friend: \emph{asistir a} means to attend; to help is usually \emph{ayudar}.
